import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# === March 31 reserve reconstruction ===
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-03-31'")
march31_reconstructed = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f"March 31 reconstructed reserves: {march31_reconstructed}")

cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-03-19'")
march19_reconstructed = cursor.fetchone()[0]
print(f"March 19 reconstructed reserves: {march19_reconstructed}")

# === March 31 circulation ===
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usdc) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date='2025-03-31' AND measure='total supply'")
total_supply_31 = cursor.fetchone()[0]
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usdc) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date='2025-03-31' AND measure='Tokens Allowed But Not Issued'")
tabni_31 = cursor.fetchone()[0]
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usdc) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date='2025-03-31' AND measure='Access Denied Tokens'")
ad_31 = cursor.fetchone()[0]
march31_circulation = total_supply_31 - tabni_31 - ad_31
print(f"March 31 total supply: {total_supply_31}")
print(f"March 31 TABNI: {tabni_31}")
print(f"March 31 AD: {ad_31}")
print(f"March 31 circulation: {march31_circulation}")

# === March 19 circulation ===
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usdc) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date='2025-03-19' AND measure='total supply'")
total_supply_19 = cursor.fetchone()[0]
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usdc) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date='2025-03-19' AND measure='Tokens Allowed But Not Issued'")
tabni_19 = cursor.fetchone()[0]
cursor.execute("SELECT SUM(amount_usdc) FROM circulation_inputs WHERE report_date='2025-03-19' AND measure='Access Denied Tokens'")
ad_19 = cursor.fetchone()[0]
march19_circulation = total_supply_19 - tabni_19 - ad_19
print(f"March 19 total supply: {total_supply_19}")
print(f"March 19 TABNI: {tabni_19}")
print(f"March 19 AD: {ad_19}")
print(f"March 19 circulation: {march19_circulation}")

# === Residual ===
cursor.execute("SELECT reported_total_usd FROM reported_reserve_totals WHERE report_date='2025-03-31'")
report_total_31 = cursor.fetchone()[0]
march31_residual = report_total_31 - march31_reconstructed
print(f"Report-stated March 31 total: {report_total_31}")
print(f"March 31 residual (report - reconstructed): {march31_residual}")

# === Coverage ===
coverage_31 = march31_reconstructed / march31_circulation * 100
coverage_19 = march19_reconstructed / march19_circulation * 100
coverage_change_bps = (coverage_31 - coverage_19) * 100
print(f"March 31 coverage: {coverage_31}%")
print(f"March 19 coverage: {coverage_19}%")
print(f"Coverage change (bps): {coverage_change_bps}")
print(f"Coverage 31 > 100%: {coverage_31 > 100}")
print(f"Coverage 19 > 100%: {coverage_19 > 100}")

# === Per-line March 31 breakdown ===
cursor.execute("SELECT component_id, amount_usd FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date='2025-03-31' ORDER BY component_id")
print("\nMarch 31 line items:")
for row in cursor.fetchall():
    print(f"  {row[0]}: {row[1]}")
